rule: Reference, never copy. A dataset is in this repository only when its licence allows redistribution and the NOTICE file names its id; every other set is fetched by a script or by hand and checked against pinned hashes. TEXBAT and JammerTest data are never redistributed. Spoofing and jamming sets are for detection benchmarking only.
review_note: An engineering review of each publisher's own page, not legal advice. 'not-stated' means the publisher's page states no licence that answers the question; such a set is not used until the owner obtains terms.

datasets.title: JammerTest 2024 GNSS receiver logs under jamming and spoofing (u-blox ZED-F9P)
datasets.publisher_licence: GNU GPL v3.0 or later (Zenodo record metadata)
datasets.checksums: SHA-256 of the archive pinned in scripts/fetch_jammertest2024.sh; per-folder hashes by kshana bench manifest
datasets.use_limits: detection benchmarking only; never redistributed by this project (the GPL stays on the data)
datasets.citation: V. Renaudin, M. I. Sayyaf, F. Le Bourhis, M. Ortiz, GNSS Positioning Under Threat, IEEE JISPIN, doi 10.1109/JISPIN.2025.3629705

datasets.title: TEXBAT, the Texas Spoofing Test Battery (UT Radionavigation Lab), GPS L1 IQ recordings
datasets.publisher_licence: use, copy and modify for research purposes; users are asked to refrain from distributing the data; commercial use not addressed
datasets.fetch: obtain from the UT Radionavigation Lab; check with kshana bench verify-manifest bench/manifests/b-iq.json --root <dir>
datasets.checksums: bench/manifests/b-iq.json (ten files, size and SHA-256 pinned)
datasets.use_limits: detection benchmarking only, research use; never redistributed
datasets.citation: T. E. Humphreys et al., The Texas Spoofing Test Battery, ION GNSS 2012

datasets.title: OAKBAT spoofing recordings (ORNL)

datasets.title: Multi-band (L1/L2/L5, E1/E5) spoofing recordings with event truth, TEXBAT-style
datasets.gap: No multi-band spoofing recording with event truth and a licence that allows benchmark use was identified in this review. A contributor's capture enters through a manifest (kshana bench manifest) and this registry; nothing that radiates is produced by this project.

datasets.title: Rail GNSS receiver logs with interference events
datasets.gap: No open rail interference log set with event truth was identified in this review.

datasets.title: Vision-aided and civil alternative-PNT logs recorded during interference events
datasets.use_limits: detection benchmarking only; integrity and detection metrics, not navigation-grade fusion
datasets.gap: No open set pairing camera or civil A-PNT logs with GNSS interference truth was identified in this review.

datasets.title: 5G and cellular timing field data during GNSS interference
datasets.gap: No open 5G timing field data with GNSS interference truth was identified in this review.
